product_thesis: Start from one selected run, teach one reasoning move, let the user open models, relations, map, and receipts without exposing raw telemetry as product copy.

layer_vocabulary.default_workspace_summary: Visible immediately or in the first read of the selected-run workspace.
layer_vocabulary.primary_product_surface: A named product surface the user intentionally opens: Learn, Models, Relations, Map, or Receipts.
layer_vocabulary.expandable_product_detail: Useful product information that should appear after a click, selection, disclosure, or detail page.
layer_vocabulary.optional_technical_inspection: Custody, telemetry, and audit data available for maintainers or careful users, not the learning path.
layer_vocabulary.agent_memory_export: A compiled memory artifact meant for future agents or advanced local use, generated explicitly.
layer_vocabulary.future_or_suggestion_only: Potential product material that needs another review/design gate before default exposure.
layer_vocabulary.internal_only: Implementation, ranking, embedding, provider, local path, or eval material that must not become product copy.
layer_vocabulary.private_hidden: Private or sensitive raw material that must stay hidden unless the user explicitly chooses a private local export.

current_visible_share.note: The current workspace shows a useful selected-run product path, but it does not yet expose the full canonical model library or full reviewed relation graph.

data_inventory.user_reason: The user must know which run or case they are reading before any lesson or graph makes sense.
data_inventory.presentation_rule: Show title, run/archive status, health, and a compact selected-run identity.
data_inventory.do_not_show: Do not show raw archive paths or raw result JSON as the first read.

data_inventory.user_reason: The first screen should answer what changed in this run.
data_inventory.presentation_rule: Show revised answer summary, strongest pressure, and compact model chips.
data_inventory.do_not_show: Do not turn the outcome into a full technical audit.

data_inventory.user_reason: The user needs early missingness: lesson available, process brief absent, conversation understanding absent or available.
data_inventory.presentation_rule: Show status chips with plain labels.
data_inventory.do_not_show: Do not expose sidecar schema details in the header.

data_inventory.user_reason: This is the teaching product: case anchor, thinking move, worked example, practice rep, and boundary.
data_inventory.presentation_rule: Make Learn the home for the reasoning move.
data_inventory.do_not_show: Do not duplicate the revised answer or raw telemetry as lesson body.

data_inventory.user_reason: The user needs clickable mental models connected to the run.
data_inventory.presentation_rule: Show selected-run model cards and detail pages with readable sections.
data_inventory.do_not_show: Do not imply the selected-run subset is the whole canonical library.

data_inventory.user_reason: Relations explain why two models together teach the move.
data_inventory.presentation_rule: Show plain-language relation story before taxonomy.
data_inventory.do_not_show: Do not present relation confidence as proof.

data_inventory.user_reason: A small map helps the user navigate model and relation pages for this run.
data_inventory.presentation_rule: Keep graph small, clickable, filtered, and explicitly not proof.
data_inventory.do_not_show: Do not pretend this is the full canonical model graph.

data_inventory.user_reason: The user needs custody, missingness, and non-claims without reading raw telemetry.
data_inventory.presentation_rule: Show trust summary, status chips, visible non-claims, and optional inspection.
data_inventory.do_not_show: Do not ask the user to review the product from inside the product.

data_inventory.user_reason: A mental model page should eventually show everything useful from the canonical model source in product language.
data_inventory.presentation_rule: Translate canonical Markdown into clean sections, source refs, examples, use/avoid, misuse, and practice prompts.
data_inventory.do_not_show: Do not dump raw Markdown or local provenance as the UI.

data_inventory.user_reason: Source custody helps a user trust where a model page came from.
data_inventory.presentation_rule: Show repo-relative source refs and hash presence only when the user opens source detail.
data_inventory.do_not_show: Do not show local absolute paths from the manifest.

data_inventory.user_reason: Hashes are useful custody receipts for model source stability.
data_inventory.presentation_rule: Show hash algorithm/value in source details if needed.
data_inventory.do_not_show: Do not make hashes feel like quality proof.

data_inventory.user_reason: Activation curation can explain use/avoid conditions and why a model appeared.
data_inventory.presentation_rule: Translate into use/avoid, reasoning types, and run-specific activation context.
data_inventory.do_not_show: Do not show routing internals as model definition.

data_inventory.user_reason: These fields can become failure modes, premortems, heuristics, and practice prompts.
data_inventory.presentation_rule: Show as teaching affordances on model pages or lessons.
data_inventory.do_not_show: Do not let extraction metadata dominate the page.

data_inventory.user_reason: Relation semantics can power relation pages and model-pair teaching.
data_inventory.presentation_rule: Show supported relation story, why it matters, misread risk, and practice prompt.
data_inventory.do_not_show: Do not surface unsupported relation speculation.

data_inventory.user_reason: Curated chunks may support future page sections when source and privacy checks pass.
data_inventory.presentation_rule: Use only translated, source-safe snippets in page details.
data_inventory.do_not_show: Do not expose internal chunk ids as the primary product.

data_inventory.user_reason: When a user clicks one mental model, they should see its reviewed direct neighbors and why each relation exists.
data_inventory.presentation_rule: Show a local graph/table on the model page with links to relation pages.
data_inventory.do_not_show: Do not expose raw affinity, rank, or embedding similarity.

data_inventory.user_reason: Maintainers need a path to inspect evidence without polluting the product path.
data_inventory.presentation_rule: Keep behind Receipts or Advanced Audit.
data_inventory.do_not_show: Do not make it the first surface.

data_inventory.user_reason: Useful for checking what the system thought the conversation meant.
data_inventory.presentation_rule: Show only if user chooses technical inspection or process brief.
data_inventory.do_not_show: Do not put extraction schema on the lesson page.

data_inventory.user_reason: Cost and call breakdowns are operational facts.
data_inventory.presentation_rule: Keep in Usage or Advanced Audit.
data_inventory.do_not_show: Do not use telemetry as product quality proof.

data_inventory.user_reason: These artifacts help maintain evidence discipline around graph quality.
data_inventory.presentation_rule: Expose only as technical inspection or maintainer diagnostics.
data_inventory.do_not_show: Do not market graph survival as human validation.

data_inventory.user_reason: A process brief may help understand how the system interpreted the run.
data_inventory.presentation_rule: Keep explicit opt-in, with status visible in Receipts.
data_inventory.do_not_show: Do not auto-generate or treat as advice correctness.

data_inventory.user_reason: A future agent can use a self-explaining memory file to understand a completed run without reopening every artifact.
data_inventory.presentation_rule: Merge first as offline export; later expose explicit generate/download/read action.
data_inventory.do_not_show: Do not make this default-on or public-safe with raw conversation.

data_inventory.user_reason: The graph substrate is much richer than the current selected-run map and can power local neighborhoods.
data_inventory.presentation_rule: Use only reviewed/productized edges through relation pages and graph filters.
data_inventory.do_not_show: Do not expose raw ranking, affinity, or edge existence as truth.

data_inventory.user_reason: It can support global navigation later, but it is too broad for the first surface.
data_inventory.presentation_rule: Use after a full-corpus graph plan and filtering rules.
data_inventory.do_not_show: Do not show full topology as the default map.

data_inventory.user_reason: Families can become filters or collections for browsing.
data_inventory.presentation_rule: Use as future library navigation after design review.
data_inventory.do_not_show: Do not present family membership as quality label.

data_inventory.user_reason: V60 affordances may power advanced teaching pages later.
data_inventory.presentation_rule: Translate only after a separate teaching-affordance gate.
data_inventory.do_not_show: Do not show raw transaction JSON or absence records.

data_inventory.user_reason: Semantic neighbors may help discovery but need review before they can become relation suggestions.
data_inventory.presentation_rule: Keep as suggestions only until reviewed.
data_inventory.do_not_show: Do not treat embedding similarity as validated relation semantics.

data_inventory.user_reason: A global graph can be valuable once local neighborhoods and filters work.
data_inventory.presentation_rule: Plan after model pages, relation pages, local neighborhoods, and performance rules exist.
data_inventory.do_not_show: Do not use the full corpus graph as the first user surface.

data_inventory.source: companion routing, activation matcher, relationship graph ranking fields
data_inventory.user_reason: Routing internals are implementation machinery.
data_inventory.presentation_rule: Use only to build safe product objects and audit panels.
data_inventory.do_not_show: Do not make ranking internals product copy.

data_inventory.user_reason: Vectors are implementation data.
data_inventory.presentation_rule: Use internally for retrieval or suggestions.
data_inventory.do_not_show: Do not expose vectors or distance scores.

data_inventory.source: provider/model outputs when present in archives
data_inventory.user_reason: Provider traces are not user product copy.
data_inventory.presentation_rule: Keep in technical custody only if retained.
data_inventory.do_not_show: Do not expose provider raw text in primary UI.

data_inventory.source: eval artifacts and Product Delta internals
data_inventory.user_reason: Eval internals support builders, not learners.
data_inventory.presentation_rule: Keep as maintainer diagnostics.
data_inventory.do_not_show: Do not turn eval internals into product proof.

data_inventory.user_reason: Source code explains behavior to builders, not end users.
data_inventory.presentation_rule: Keep code internal and tests focused on product contracts.
data_inventory.do_not_show: Do not render implementation code as product help text.

data_inventory.user_reason: Local paths are private implementation details.
data_inventory.presentation_rule: Strip or translate to repo-relative source refs.
data_inventory.do_not_show: Do not expose user machine paths.

data_inventory.user_reason: The raw conversation may be private and too large for the product surface.
data_inventory.presentation_rule: Only include through explicit private local export.
data_inventory.do_not_show: Do not show by default or include in public-safe memory.

data_inventory.user_reason: Private/operator material may be useful for debugging but not for product.
data_inventory.presentation_rule: Inventory without copying bodies unless a private local mode explicitly permits it.
data_inventory.do_not_show: Do not render private ledgers in the user workspace.

current_visible_graph.note: The current Map is a small selected-run graph. It is not evidence that a model has only one relation.

graph_substrate.gap: The current visible Map under-represents the known relation substrate. The next graph slice should add model-detail local neighborhoods before attempting a global full-corpus graph.

conversation_memory_bundle.merge_recommendation: Review and merge as offline export capability only before any Observatory UI integration.
